primary_reading_extent.extent_and_limits: Checked the indexed primary title and copyright page: first published 1990, with the original title AD 990–1990. The later AD 990–1992 revision remains distinct. The chapter body is not used as substantive evidence.

Read the full institutional obituary, dates and selected works. It states birth on May 27, 1929 and death on April 29, 2008. Its inconsistent date for The Contentious French is not adopted; an existing publisher-reviewed source independently grounds that publication year.

Read printed 169–172 of the primary chapter scan. The argument is tentative and concerns European state formation. Tilly rejects reading contemporary countries’ futures directly from Europe’s past. Editor credits are retained; the rest of the chapter remains unread.

relationship_scope.claim: War finance and organized coercion help shape European state formation
